opener.dateline:
LAWRENCE HALL, KIRKLAND STREET
CAMBRIDGE, MASSACHUSETTS
July 29, 1943

div.p: At the request of the Government, American Defense – Harvard Group is making a survey of the educational and scholarly personnel of Germany, Italy, Japan, Hungary, Austria, Czechoslovakia, Rumania, Bulgaria, Finland. I am writing to see if you will be so good as to supply me with information regarding teachers or investigators in the field of education and related flieds with whom you are directly or indirectly acquainted, and who, to the best of your knowledge, are at present in one of the above countries.

The primary purpose of the inquiry is to collect brief biographical records and estimates of individuals who can be relied on for personal integrity, disinterestedness and intellectual honesty; who enjoy a good reputation and exert influence in their communities; and who possess expert competence in their subjects or professions. Any information which you may provide will be held in strict confidence, and its source will not appear on the record. It will be used with discretion, and only to advance the declared aims and policies of the United States with regard to the several countries named, during the war and the immediate post-war period.
In supplying information, please use the enclosed questionnaire (FROM HA), and observe the following directions:
1. Questions filled or crossed (xxx) need not be answered, the information being already available from other sources.
2. Leave blank any questions which you do not deem yourself competent to answer either from your knowledge or after consultation with other sources.
3. Do not attach your name to the questionnaire, but attach the questionnaire to your return covering letter, and pencil your initials lightly at top of the first sheet.
4. Whenever relevant, indicate accuracy and recency of your information.
5. Enter on FROM HB the names of other sources from whom you have obtained information on any given person, together with your estimate of their reliability.
6. Under Comments (FROM HA) give any additional suggestions which you think would serve the purpose of the inquiry.
7. Address your reply to Robert Ulich, Graduate School of Education, Harvard University, Cambridge, Massachusetts.
div.closer:
Very truly yours, Robert Ulich
Robert Ulich Professor Paul Tillich
99 Claremont Avenue
New York, New York

*In the case of Italy distinguish between before and after 1922; in the case of Germany and other European countries allied to, or dominated by, Germany, distinguish between before and after 1933.

IV. Estimate and appraisal:
1) Standing in his occupation or field of scholarship
2) Intellectual integrity and standards of scholarship
3) Character and reliability
4) Executive or administrative capacity
5) Leadership, influence, and esteem in the community

This questionnaire should ordinarily be sent when filled to American Defense--Harvard Group, Room P, Widener Library, Cambridge, Massachusetts; but may be sent, if preferred, to Biographical Records Section, Office of Strategic Services, Washington, D.C.
